note: Every known-flaky test, in one place. CI runs these first and alone (ci.sh --group flaky, a failure fails the job, a board unit gets one retry and a pass on it is marked PASSED ON RETRY, a go test gets none) and every other step skips them. kind is go (package is the import path under the module, name is the test function) board (name is the headless unit) or script (a check script run once, by its path). A test enters the first time it fails in CI and is not listed and leaves after 30 quiet runs: docs/troubleshooting-tests.md. test-board-sharded.js reads the board entries for its retry labels. scripts/check-flaky-suite.js fails when a name no longer exists.
